author: Bar Winkler
title: Wonderful Greece
bodyHtml:
Greek enterprises face unique challenges: a linguistically complex language underserved by mainstream AI models, customer service that cannot be outsourced abroad, and a market where efficiency is critical. These realities make scaling customer operations both costly and difficult. At the same time, Greece is home to a tech-savvy population, a fast-growing digital economy, and a business community eager for transformation, creating strong demand for advanced AI solutions tailored to local needs.

"Wonderful is proof of the talent and energy in Greece today. Collaborating with their team means moving fast, meeting high standards, and seeing scalable ideas come to life - an approach that supports Greek enterprises in becoming globally competitive."

Antonis Avgeropoulos
CEO, Nespresso Greece

Launching in Greece marks a huge step in bringing enterprise-ready AI to markets often overlooked by today’s global platforms. It reflects our commitment to building technology that adapts to local languages, regulations, and business realities, ensuring enterprises can deliver world-class service at scale.

We are already partnering with some of Greece’s largest banks, telcos, and logistics companies, for customer support use cases and beyond. By creating AI that understands and generates Greek with precision and cultural fluency, we aim to become the trusted partner for enterprises across the country.

"Greece is the perfect market for Wonderful: a linguistically complex and historically underserved language, where customer support remains costly and limited. Wonderful overcomes that. By providing state-of-the-art AI tools comparable to those used in the US today, we empower Greek enterprises to become globally competitive."

Ilia Tzortzopoulou
General Manager, Wonderful Greece

We’ve built a team on the ground in Greece and continue to expand. Explore our careers to see open roles and join us in shaping the future of enterprise AI.
